label: no-dlc-load-test
_why: THE NO-DLC LOAD TEST (POLISH_1_0.md 'Where it stands'; the user, 2026-10-21: "Run the no-DLC load test after the batch, before the release build"). The only proof of the DLC rule (CLAUDE.md §5.1 rule 1) beyond the file comparison of check_dlc_gates.mjs: a game with every installed DLC disabled loads the 1.0 canon, plays five years, and its error.log is read by position. A vanilla control arm with the same DLCs disabled separates vanilla's own no-DLC noise from anything the mod adds, since errors in the ~146 vanilla-path files the mod replaces do not name a zzz_pm_rehaul file. Every run sets no_dlc: run_observer -DisableAllDlc writes each installed DLC's pops_id into content_load.json's disabledDLC, and meta.json records dlc_mounted and no_dlc_verified from debug.log's 'Mounted Data: ...\game\dlc\...' lines.

_arms.vanilla: {kind: control} - vanilla + telemetry and nothing else, every installed DLC disabled
_arms.canon: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99.json} - the 1.0 canon, sha256 728f2c7f84e6f467 (tree twin 04ac513168388956), a debug build (telemetry on), every installed DLC disabled

_comparison: canon no-DLC error.log against vanilla no-DLC error.log (same span, same telemetry), and both against the canon's ordinary smoke run 20261021_220806_polish-final-smoke (1 x 1836->1841 with every DLC) for the classes that disabling DLC adds
_predictions: Both runs load and play to 1841.1.1, and both meta.json files read no_dlc_verified true. No error line names a zzz_pm_rehaul file, and the canon adds no error class beyond the vanilla no-DLC arm's except classes the vanilla-noise catalogue already lists. Magnitude not argued: vanilla's own no-DLC noise has never been measured here.
_cost: 2 x 1836 -> 1841, ~10 min each with the build (the smoke run played 1836->1841 in 7.3 min)
